heading: What customers can expect.
subtext: Same operational standard across every trade. Written quotes, branded crew, on-site supervisor, photos at end-of-job, and a 1-year workmanship warranty on every line of work.
cardLead: Same backbone whether it's a one-hour handyman call or a six-week basement finish-out — the trade and timeline differ, the standards don't.
benefits: Free phone-quote or in-home estimate before any work starts — no commitment
Written scope and price emailed before scheduling, so you know exactly what's included
Branded Apex truck, uniformed crew, and an on-site supervisor for any job over half a day
Text the day before with arrival window; text again when the truck is on the way
Daily clean-up on remodel projects — you can use the kitchen at night even when we're remodeling it
End-of-job walkthrough with the crew lead, before-and-after photos sent to your phone
Same-day invoicing by email; pay by card, check, or ACH on small jobs, milestones on remodels
1-year workmanship warranty on every job, handyman through remodel
note: We're not licensed for major plumbing or HVAC work — for those we refer to two trusted partners we've used for years. We're also not a re-roofer or a full siding contractor; small repairs yes, full replacements we'll point you elsewhere. We'd rather be honest about scope up front than be three weeks into a job we shouldn't have taken.
